title: P2RLN LTI Profile
description: Represents portable external-tool intent and LTI links without transporting platform credentials or pretending that a legacy Basic LTI link is already an LTI 1.3 registration.
rules: Private keys, client secrets, access tokens and platform deployment credentials MUST NOT be transported in P2RLN.
An imported LTI resource MUST be rebound to a local platform registration/deployment before launch when the required registration is not already available.
Legacy Basic LTI links MAY be projected as external-tool intent but MUST declare their source version and rebindRequired=true; they MUST NOT be mislabeled as native LTI 1.3 registrations.
Deep Linking content-item semantics SHOULD be preserved when available.
